title: 376. Find the Celebrity

examples.explanation: Person 1 is known by 0 and 2 while knowing nobody else.
No person satisfies both celebrity conditions.
Person 0 knows nobody else and person 1 knows 0.

hints: Adaptation: the knows API is given as an adjacency matrix graph where graph[i][j] is 1 when i knows j (diagonal ignored).
Eliminate non-candidates: if candidate knows i, candidate cannot be the celebrity so move to i.
Verify the survivor knows nobody else and is known by everyone; else return -1.
